front: Leave a faint glowing path behind you as you move, visible or invisible, showing your size but not your form.
back:
Path hangs in space, tracking your movement through the air; not anchored to surfaces. It fades after 10 minutes. You can Dismiss the spell, but the path fades normally.
Visible: faint mist in a color of your choice, sheds no light. Invisible: you can still detect it.
Heightened (3rd): fades after 1 day.
(5th): 1 week.
(7th): 1 month.
(9th): 1 year.
